title: BGG resolutions, Koszulity, and stratifications, part II: the Jacobi-Trudi algebra
summary: We categorify the Jacobi-Trudi determinant formula for Schur functions as a shadow of a highest-weight phenomenon by considering certain quasi-hereditary quotients of certain cyclotomic KLR algebras, which we call ``Jacobi-Trudi algebras''. These algebras come equipped with a map from $\mathbb{C} S_n$, and we show that the dominant simple modules for these algebras admit BGG resolutions which, when restricted to $\mathbb{C} S_n$, become resolutions of Specht modules by permutation modules.
